name: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Limited
summary: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Limited manufactures, sells, and provides services for rail and rail related products in India. It operates through four segments: Freight Car Division, Infra Rail & Green Energy, Infra Electrical, and Real Estate. The company offers freight cars, such as railway freight cars, loco components and shells, and steel castings; steel girders for railway bridges; and pressure vessels. It also undertakes EPC contracts for execution of railway track, and signaling and telecommunication projects; rail electrification and automatic fare collection; hydro-mechanical equipment.
